headline: AI adoption lifts profit for several firms while top‑line growth remains modest for the majors.
summary: Revenue growth varied widely, from Coforge's 53.6% surge to Infosys' 1.5% rise. Profit grew strongly at HCLTech (+21%) and Coforge (+56.5%) as AI‑led contracts expanded. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, signalling caution on macro demand. Overall operating margins stayed healthy, with TCS at 24% and OFSS unusually high at 47.8%.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed double‑digit revenue growth at LTM, HCLTech, TCS and Mphasis, and was highlighted as a profit driver at Coforge.

themes.title: Margin stability
themes.detail: Operating margins remained above 15% for most peers, with TCS at 24% and OFSS at an outlier 47.8%.
